The '''Mischievous Miniprobe''' was a model of floating [[miniprobe]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] available<ref name="Reveal" /> around [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} mentions that the [[Dantooine Incursion]] took place in 3627 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> This small droid came equipped with a confetti launcher attached to its underside.<ref name="Reveal" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> droid debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[October 23]], [[2018]].<ref name="Reveal" />
